name: InspectorInput
label: Inspector input
description: One-row text field for inspector panels, with the name on the left and the value right-aligned in the bar.

props.name: label
props.description: The setting's name, drawn inside the bar on the left, as the field's real <label>.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type: a curated subset of the single-line text types.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size, matching Button: `default` is 40px tall, `compact` 32px (not the native character-width `size` attribute).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the value directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature
so form libraries work unmodified.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the bar rather than the <input>.
